description: European Environment Agency: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in EEA SDI - geospatial data catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by European Environment Agency. Coverage: European Environment Agency. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Urban Atlas Street Tree Layer 2012 (vector), Europe, 6-yearly, May 201; Urban Atlas Street Tree Layer 2018 (vector), Europe, 6-yearly, Feb. 20; Urban Atlas Street Tree Layer 2021 (vector), Europe, 3-yearly, Jan. 20. Formats seen: WMS, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-eea-sdi.
